generated_for: POTRAZ AI for Impact Challenge 2026 · Track 1: Data
note: This file is the single source of truth for validation. scripts/validate.py reads it rather than hard-coding thresholds, so a reviewer can change a threshold here and re-run without touching code.
mode_note: 'specification' means the records in processed/ are illustrative examples dated inside the PLANNED collection window (2026-09-01 onward), which is still in the future. In this mode a future collection date is reported as informational, because it is expected. Switch to 'production' on the first real ingest: the same date then becomes a hard failure. Nothing else about the check changes — this is a declared mode, not a suppressed rule.
ecozone_quota_note: The quota names three zones and only three. Collection is not confined to them — a holder leads the team to a roadside stand of trees or the bush behind a homestead, and ecozone 'Other' admits that sample rather than refusing it. Out-of-frame samples are reported by V24 and are NEVER counted toward the quota, so the 200/150/150 target cannot be met by relabelling convenience collection. V24 exists to keep that visible: if the out-of-frame share grows, the sampling design has drifted and the number says so.

checks.name: schema_insert
checks.description: Every record is inserted through the DDL in schema/schema.sql. Type, range, controlled vocabulary and cross-field constraints are enforced by the database, not by this script. A record that will not insert is not admitted to the bank.

checks.name: critical_field_completeness
checks.description: Each field listed in critical_fields must be populated on at least 95% of records in the batch.

checks.name: identifier_format
checks.description: Primary keys must match the documented identifier pattern for their table.

checks.name: primary_key_uniqueness
checks.description: No identifier may appear twice in an ingest batch. Identifiers are never reissued.

checks.name: near_duplicate_sample
checks.description: Two samples of the same type, at the same coordinates, on the same date, from the same collector are flagged as possible double entry.

checks.name: checksum_format
checks.description: Every record referencing a raw file must carry a well-formed SHA-256.

checks.name: source_id_resolves
checks.description: Every source_id must resolve to a row in governance/source_register.csv.

checks.name: consent_reference_matches_heritage
checks.description: A knowledge-led sample must cite the same consent document as the heritage record it points to.

checks.name: consent_log_agreement
checks.description: Every heritage record's consent reference, council endorsement and withdrawal status must agree with governance/consent_log.csv.

checks.name: withdrawal_propagation
checks.description: When a holder withdraws, no linked sample may remain active. Unactioned records hold the batch until resolved inside the 30-day commitment.

checks.name: heritage_link_agreement
checks.description: The denormalised heritage_link on a sequence must match the parent sample's heritage_use_ref.

checks.name: location_masking
checks.description: Any record in a public release tier must be masked, and a masked record must declare degraded coordinate precision.

checks.name: no_direct_identifiers
checks.description: Scans free-text fields for patterns resembling personal names, phone numbers or national ID numbers that would defeat pseudonymisation.

checks.name: translation_verified
checks.description: A record whose translation is not human_verified is held out of every release tier.

checks.name: annotation_confidence_honesty
checks.description: MSI level 3 or 4 features are putative. They carry a warning so they are never reported as identifications.

checks.name: preservation_latency
checks.description: Time from collection to stabilisation above the target threshold flags the sample for degradation review.

checks.name: sequence_quality
checks.description: Mean Phred score below the threshold makes downstream taxonomic assignment provisional.

checks.name: collection_window
checks.description: Collection dates must fall inside the declared collection window for their source and must not be in the future.

checks.name: language_representation
checks.description: Ndebele-language heritage records must make up at least 30% of the active corpus.

checks.name: ecozone_coverage
checks.description: Reports progress against the 200/150/150 ecozone quota and flags any zone at less than half the expected share of collection to date.

checks.name: seasonal_coverage
checks.description: Every ecozone must eventually carry both dry and wet season records; a single-season ecozone confounds season with site.

checks.name: machine_loading
checks.description: Every processed file must load into pandas and into SQL without manual editing. Implemented in scripts/machine_loading_test.py and required by Minimum Expectations §6.3.

checks.name: manifest_integrity
checks.description: Every file in manifest.csv must exist and match its recorded SHA-256. Implemented in scripts/build_manifest.py --verify.

checks.name: out_of_frame_coverage
checks.description: Reports the share of active samples collected outside the three named ecozones. These are admitted, not refused — collection follows the holder, not the sampling frame — but they do not count toward the quota, and a rising share means the design has drifted toward convenience collection. Warns above 25%.

checks.name: locality_for_out_of_frame
checks.description: A sample with ecozone 'Other' must carry a locality_description. Enforced as a CHECK in the DDL (rule D5): with no zone name describing the site, the free text is the only thing that makes it findable again.

release_blocked_by: critical field completeness below 0.95 on any table
any heritage record below translation_status 'human_verified' being included in a release tier
release_permitted_with_warnings: MSI level 3-4 annotations, provided they are labelled putative
mean Q score below 10, provided assignments are marked provisional
preservation latency above target, provided the sample is flagged for degradation review

pass_warning_fail_definition.pass: The record satisfies the check and may enter the bank.
pass_warning_fail_definition.warning: The record enters the bank carrying a documented caveat that downstream users must honour.
pass_warning_fail_definition.fail: The record is not admitted. The batch is held until the issue is corrected or formally waived with a recorded owner and action.
